content.en_US:
The relay satellite allows [[redstone-over-radio|Redstone over Radio]] signals to be sent to different dimensions. It only acts as a transmitter, it cannot receive signals from other dimensions.

* '§erelay §e §e §e§r' will create a signal in the selected dimension using the supplied channel and signal contents. The dimension ID is numeric, the overworld uses ID 0, the nether -1 and the end 1.
